name: Restoring Friendship
overview: Restoring friendship requires intentional kindness and forgiveness, reflecting the example of Christ who forgave us (Ephesians 4:32). Genuine friendship is marked by faithfulness and openness, as one must show themselves friendly to have true friends who can be closer than a brother (Proverbs 18:24). When offenses occur, Scripture calls for honest confrontation and repentance, followed by forgiveness (Luke 17:3), while covering sin leads to failure, but confessing and forsaking sin brings mercy (Proverbs 28:13). Believers are urged to pursue peace and refrain from repaying evil for evil, seeking to act honorably toward all (Romans 12:17; Romans 5:1).
